semantics.reason: Strict replication keeps the 005F observable BBO-change construction; V3-only best_bid_ask is reserved for a capture-quality challenger/falsification.
semantics.representative_token_rule: one representative token per binary condition, using token_ids[0]; avoids complementary duplicate weighting and mirrors 005F yes-token de-duplication for orientation-invariant targets
semantics.genuine_bbo: valid contiguous BBO group with best_bid or best_ask changed from previous observable group
semantics.update_h300: at least one future genuine_bbo strictly after t and through t+300s
semantics.jump_threshold: TRAIN-only 95th percentile of abs 15s logit-mid return, fixed on DEV/HOLDOUT
semantics.jump_h300: future absolute 300s logit-mid return >= frozen TRAIN jump threshold
semantics.trade_abs_impact_60: mean absolute trade-price displacement from immediately-prior observable midpoint over trailing 60s completed 5s bins; exact-time quote/trade matches excluded
semantics.spread_h15: future spread minus current spread at 15s, same continuity segment

ACTIVE_RESULTS_CORE_EV18.note: Five-hour core window kept within the original 005F +6h ACTIVE_RESULTS convention while aligning all splits to hourly source files.

PRE_ELECTION_BASELINE_SEP.note: 120h current-universe V3 slice with exact 60/20/20 chronological split and file-aligned sealed holdout.

holdout_rule: No HOLDOUT file may be downloaded or scanned before PRE_HOLDOUT_FREEZE hashes the selected candidates, code/config, dataset identity and dev evidence.

computational_sampling.rule: Sampling is applied only to completed clock rows after full raw-state, trade-feature, target, split, purge and continuity construction. Raw input/state construction is never sampled.

active_ev18.effect: none; every eligible 15s clock row is retained

pre_baseline.rationale: Bound model-frame memory on the 96-hour current-universe V3 TRAIN/DEV slice without changing raw state or target construction.
pre_baseline.candidate_thinning_after_sampling: The existing 005F MAX_MODEL_ROWS=250000 deterministic thinning rule remains in force candidate-by-candidate.
